summary: Comprehensive testing of dynamic product page for Giftyne.com completed. Nearly all functionality working correctly with excellent UI implementation.

ui_bugs.issue: Thumbnail clicks not changing main image - thumbnails 1, 2, and 3 don't update main image when clicked

passed_tests: Product page loads at /product/chain-gift-wrapping-paper
Product title displays 'Chain Gift Wrapping Paper'
Price displays ₹999 correctly
Rating shows 4.8 stars with (47 reviews)
Breadcrumb navigation: Home / Wrapping Paper / Chain Gift Wrapping Paper
Image gallery shows main image + 4 thumbnails
Variant selector with 4 color swatches (Golden, Black, Blue, Peach Chain)
Quantity selector: starts at 1, plus/minus buttons work, cannot go below 1
Add to Cart button shows 'Add to Cart — ₹999' and changes to 'Added to Cart!' on click
Wishlist heart button toggles correctly
Trust signals display: Secure Checkout, Free Shipping above ₹999, 7-Day Easy Returns
Description tab shows product sections and features
Specifications tab shows product specs table
Reviews tab shows 4.8 rating, distribution bars, 3 verified reviews
Related Products section shows 4 related product cards
Back to Shop link navigates to homepage
Product not found page works for invalid slug /product/nonexistent
Homepage product cards link to product pages
Related product navigation works correctly
Quantity updates price in Add to Cart button (qty 2 shows ₹1,998)
Zoom modal opens and closes correctly on main image click
success_percentage: frontend: 95% (1 minor UI issue out of 21 tested features)
